label: practice

test_cases.label: to_linked_list() returns sorted LinkedList
test_cases.code:
bst = BST()
assert str(bst.to_linked_list()) == '()'
for x in [4, 1, 3, 6, 7, 5, 8]: bst.insert(x)
assert str(bst.to_linked_list()) == '(1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)'

test_cases.label: remove() handles leaf, single-child, and two-child root nodes
test_cases.code:
bst = BST()
for x in [10, 5, 3, 8, 1, 4, 6, 9, 2, 7]: bst.insert(x)
bst.remove(2)
assert str(bst) == '<1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10>'
bst.remove(1)
assert str(bst) == '<3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10>'
bst.remove(5)
assert str(bst) == '<3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10>'
bst.remove(10)
assert str(bst) == '<3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9>'
